title: Review verdict
description: Result of the review command: is what was built what was asked for, with the artefacts that prove it. success is false if and only if at least one issue is a blocker.

success.description: True when no issue has severity blocker.

summary.description: What was built, whether it matches the spec, and what the artefacts show.

artefacts_reviewed.description: Path of every artefact the reviewer opened.

severity.description: blocker: must not ship as is. tech_debt: safe to ship, cost to pay later. skippable: cosmetic or preference.

description.description: What is wrong, with path:line where applicable.

resolution.description: The change that would close the issue.

artefact.description: Path of the artefact that shows the issue; empty string when none.

criterion.description: The Proof plan criterion the issue is about (C1, C2, …); empty string when none.

kind.description: Who can clear it. fixable: an agent's patch. needs-environment: a tool, engine, host or network the run lacks. needs-declaration: the layer author adds a declaration. needs-person: a decision only a person may take.
